source_quality_caveats: 101 are lot-level/research signals, not unique official EIS numbers or all-Russian procurement population
Only 12 records have numeric scalar 6–35kV equipment_voltage_kv in normalized rows; other records may include nominal voltage in description or a multi-voltage set
Contract source tier is not automatically supplier identity; verified original RD223 contracts often lack readable winner
Market price surveys and requests for quotation do not imply sale or signed contract
High-voltage 110/220kV mixed EPC projects cannot be summed as 6–35kV equipment revenue
One original Rosseti 26-1174 BOM is SHA-verified, many secondary sources lack original attachments
Prior 71 Data Platform v12 records production imported, 30 new v13-v18 research observations not production imported
No comprehensive raw EIS 44/223-FZ and commercial ETP tender universe export yet
